scientific_question: Can a label-blind, cost-bounded selected-minimum local-RRHO surrogate expose a reproducible MLIP-dependent conformational contribution for fixed AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE Route 1, before any larger or accuracy-promoting study?

source.selection_rule: For target state counts [1,2,8,20,40,150], choose without replacement among manifest cases with atom_count <= 23 the case minimizing absolute log(state_count/target); tie-break by lower atom_count then compound_id. No label or model outcome is used.
source.labels_forbidden_until: The complete 18-model-case energy, optimization, Hessian, frequency, thermochemistry, and surrogate-prediction artifact has been atomically written and sealed with its content SHA256.

implementation_freeze.amendment_policy: Any source or required-version change before v8 execution requires a visibly versioned protocol amendment while labels remain sealed; changes after any v8 model-case energy execution or post-seal label access invalidate the preregistered inference.

seed_ranking.gas: ascending U_g,m, then ascending source state index
seed_ranking.solution: ascending U_s,m, then ascending source state index

phase_specific_sampling.seed_diversity: Walk the phase ranking and accept a state only when its Kabsch-aligned heavy-atom RMSD exceeds 0.125 angstrom from every already accepted seed; stop after three accepted states or exhaustion.
phase_specific_sampling.selected_seed_terminal_requirement: Every selected seed must finish as one valid unique minimum or an explicitly recorded duplicate of a valid unique minimum; optimization failure, nonconvergence, or invalid Hessian invalidates the model-case.
phase_specific_sampling.seed_budget_convergence_reason: A 1/2/3 prefix would require separate Hessian analyses after prefix-specific re-deduplication; v6 does not infer convergence from the final three-seed set or from a post hoc subset.

optimized_minimum_deduplication.scope: within one phase, model, and case
optimized_minimum_deduplication.ordering: ascending final phase potential, then ascending source state index
optimized_minimum_deduplication.duplicate_action: retain the lower-potential minimum and record the rejected branch as a duplicate
optimized_minimum_deduplication.statistical_weight_interpretation: Unit weight is a lower-information selected-basin approximation; duplicate arrival count is not degeneracy and unknown basin volume is not recovered.
optimized_minimum_deduplication.rotational_symmetry_number_source: frozen per case and separate from conformer degeneracy

hessian_and_stationary_point.method: central finite difference of the complete phase force
hessian_and_stationary_point.vibrational_mode_selection: After mass-weighted rigid-body projection, select exactly 3N-5 modes for a linear molecule or 3N-6 modes otherwise by largest absolute frequency; the unselected rigid complement must remain within the frozen leakage gate.
hessian_and_stationary_point.imaginary_mode_policy: Any selected vibrational frequency below 0 cm-1 invalidates the minimum. No selected negative frequency is replaced by its absolute value in the primary or sensitivity thermochemistry.

displacement_sensitivity.failure_action: A failed displacement sensitivity gate invalidates the affected model-case and blocks the six-case pilot.
displacement_sensitivity.scope_interpretation: The rigid one-state nitromethane anchor checks plumbing; the flexible 19-state 1-acetoxyethyl acetate case checks a low-frequency multi-conformer basin. This remains a targeted numerical preflight, not a proof for every flexible molecule.

hessian_and_stationary_point.failure_action: Retain the model-case in the denominator, mark it incomplete, and close every accuracy or promotion claim; do not replace the case, model, selected branch, minimum, or checkpoint.
hessian_and_stationary_point.numerical_quality_gate: Every raw finite-difference Hessian must pass both the broad absolute nonconservative-force sanity ceiling and the scale-aware Frobenius asymmetry gate before symmetrization; selected frequencies must independently pass the frozen displacement-sensitivity gate.

label_blind_numerical_qualification.selection_boundary: Thresholds were selected only from three-MLIP force/Hessian/frequency stability and saddle recovery evidence; no FreeSolv experimental value or error statistic was read.

imaginary_mode_recovery.trigger: At least one selected vibrational mode is below 0 cm-1 after a force-converged optimization and all raw-Hessian numerical-quality gates pass.
imaginary_mode_recovery.selected_mode: most negative selected projected vibrational mode
imaginary_mode_recovery.selection: Reoptimize both directions with the frozen phase potential and choose the lower converged total energy; ties resolve to direction -1.
imaginary_mode_recovery.post_recovery_requirement: The accepted structure must pass the same force, raw-Hessian, stationary-point, rigid-leakage, and displacement-sensitivity gates; otherwise the model-case fails closed.
imaginary_mode_recovery.deduplication_boundary: Recompute duplicate evidence after recovery; if unique-minimum membership changes, fail closed rather than silently altering weights.

primary.name: Local harmonic RRHO primary; low-frequency rotor interpolation is excluded from the primary to avoid unquantified double counting with the explicit selected-minimum sum.

thermochemistry.torsional_double_counting_boundary: Because multiple selected minima already represent part of torsional configurational space, applying qRRHO/free-rotor treatment can double count torsional entropy; those variants are sensitivity diagnostics only until a mode-to-torsion de-duplication rule is independently frozen.
thermochemistry.rotational_partition_policy: Retain the geometry-dependent local Q_rot,j/sigma_rot,j in each local basin; this is a local rovibrational metric, not an uncancelled global orientation or standard-state factor.
thermochemistry.rotational_symmetry_number_policy: Use the frozen per-case external rigid-rotor rotational_symmetry_number; keep internal-rotor permutation symmetry, conformer degeneracy, and duplicate arrival count separate.

standard_state.transfer_convention: 1 mol/L gas to 1 mol/L solution, matching FreeSolv
standard_state.reason_translation_is_omitted: At the same temperature, molecular identity, and 1 mol/L standard concentration, the common center-of-mass translational factor cancels between the two phase partition sums.
standard_state.warning: Do not add approximately 1.89 kcal/mol to a Route 1 solvent endpoint that is already interpreted in the FreeSolv 1 M to 1 M convention.

limitations: This selected-minimum local-RRHO surrogate is not the exact Cartesian endpoint integral and does not establish basin completeness.
The continuum equilibrium model contains no explicit solvent cage or solvent friction.
Unit statistical weights avoid search-path overcounting but do not recover unknown conformer degeneracies or basin volumes.
qRRHO/free-rotor variants are sensitivity diagnostics because explicit minima plus rotor interpolation can double count torsional entropy.

ensemble_estimator.local_partition_surrogate: Z_tilde_p,m=sum_j [Q_rot,j/sigma_rot,j] Q_vib,j exp[-U_p,m(R_p,m,j)/(RT)] over the frozen selected unique minima
ensemble_estimator.primary_baseline: The frozen single-reference AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE endpoint from the source manifest; it is identical for all three gas-phase MLIPs.
ensemble_estimator.secondary_baseline: The zero-kelvin separately optimized minimum diagnostic computed from the same accepted minima.
ensemble_estimator.global_factor_cancellation: At identical 1 M conventions, common center-of-mass translation, global orientation-group volume, and momentum factors cancel in the exact endpoint ratio; the geometry-dependent local Q_rot,j/sigma_rot,j retained here belongs only to the local-basin approximation.

post_seal_scoring.experimental_source: FreeSolv experimental hydration free energies under the documented 1 M gas to 1 M solution convention
post_seal_scoring.route_accuracy_gate: At least two of three MLIPs pass the positive model gate, and no remaining MLIP has both a point degradation of at least 0.2 kcal/mol and a bootstrap upper bound below 0.

low_frequency_stability_gate.instability: Maximum absolute deviation of any predeclared sensitivity prediction from the primary prediction exceeds the threshold.

post_seal_scoring.decision: Any incomplete artifact or failed diagnostic gate falsifies this six-case selected-minimum local-RRHO development pilot. Passing does not promote an absolute hydration method; it only permits a separately preregistered larger seed-budget and held-out study.

claim_boundary.reason: This is a six-case cost-bounded development falsification of a selected-minimum local-RRHO surrogate. It tests whether MLIP-dependent phase reorganization is reproducible under fixed AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE; it cannot establish exact endpoint integration, basin completeness, or external accuracy.

amendment_reason: After the three label-blind v7 nitromethane model-cases succeeded and before aggregate sealing or any experimental-label access, static analysis found one missing isinstance guard on a Hessian evidence path. v8 adds only that behavior-preserving type narrowing, records v7 as invalidated under its own source-freeze policy, and requires the identical three-model preflight to be rerun. The Route 1 formula, AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE endpoint, cases, models, Hessian gates, imaginary-mode recovery, thermochemistry, scorer, and claim boundaries are unchanged.

execution.record_granularity: one atomically sealed JSON file per model-case
execution.resume_policy: skip only a complete self-hash-valid successful record that passes the shared v8 scientific schema validator for the exact protocol/model/case

repeat_tolerance_provenance.selection: A pre-execution engineering ceiling of 0.0002 kcal/mol is above the frozen prior maximum but remains negligible relative to the 0.2 kcal/mol accuracy-effect gate; no experimental labels were used.

semantic_requirements: complete finite source-state repeat arrays and derived repeat gate
deterministic cost-bounded source selection and phase-specific seed selection
every selected branch resolves as one converged unique valid minimum or an explicit duplicate
optimization convergence, exact solution OBC-II/ACE component closure, and frozen external AM1-BCC provenance
repository-contained content-hashed Hessian with shape, absolute and scale-aware raw-asymmetry, no-selected-imaginary-mode, rigid-leakage, and preregistered displacement-sensitivity checks
frozen per-case rotational symmetry number, thermochemistry, ensemble, and surrogate-prediction closure
evidence_sealing.durable_storage: Before aggregate sealing, complete records and content-addressed Hessian NPY files are copied from .omx into the fixed repository-relative <energy-artifact-stem>-raw sibling directory and revalidated.
